answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of committed task data and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse. Since that pulse is unknown until signature release, a swarm cannot precompute valid answers or farm them offline. Verification binds each reveal to its commitment and beacon, making substitution detectable. A reef of identities gains no benefit from cached work: each must respond after the pulse, even if copper-fast automation races to act on the signal.
